images.caption: Figure 1:A GUI agent reaches the deep state through a long pixel-action sequence, whereas StatePortal synthesizes a checkpoint and restores the target state directly. Figure 2:StatePortal on a Luanti workshop task. Shared source exploration supports joint synthesis of the Start checkpoint and transition, with state changes shown below the scenes.
Figure 3:Validated deep states of all ten applications, tagged by domain family (Figure4).

Table 4:Scale, tests, and external runtime affordances across five browser and nine engine-backed games. Static complexity overlaps, while automation-ready state, view, and transition surfaces concentrate in browser games; no engine project has a full-runtime interaction test.
Table 6:Examples of DeepStateBench preconditions and simplified hidden evaluation scripts. Screenshots show the restored Start states; descriptions and checks are abridged.
